What I'm Doing Now

A living status page inspired by the /now movement

Last updated: February 2026

This is my /now page — a snapshot of what I'm currently focused on, inspired by the /now movement. It's updated regularly as my work and priorities evolve.

Current Projects

Corridor Peer Pathways

Building out the open-source peer support resource map for Eastern Iowa's I-380 corridor. Currently expanding coverage across Johnson and Linn Counties with 70+ verified organizations.

HALLway

Developing a NixOS-based privacy-first operating system stack. Current focus: Home Manager integration, agenix secrets management, and ZFS storage architecture.

socialize.sh

Early-stage research into what camera apps' Social Media depth features really do with your photos and metadata.

This Site

Continuously improving this living portfolio/blog/starter kit. Recent work: MVC architecture refactor separating Nunjucks layouts from Markdown content.

Day Job

Senior Fresh Starts Janitor and Peer Support Specialist at Shelter House Iowa, working out of 501 Southgate in Iowa City.

The bridge: This isn't separate from my dev work — it's the same mission expressed differently. Building systems that respect and empower the people inside them.

Learning & Exploring

NixOS and Nix Flakes

Deep-diving into declarative system configuration and reproducible builds

Privacy Engineering

Exploring local-first architecture and data sovereignty patterns

Static Site Architecture
